items.title: Sebi aims to make capital markets more accessible, resilient: Chairman
items.description: Pandey said that companies have raised over ₹10 lakh crore annually through equity and debt issuances, while West Bengal's investor base has grown from 12 lakh in FY15 to over 90 lakh

items.title: Sebi bars EKI Energy, MD Dabkara, others from market; imposes penalty
items.description: Besides, Sebi has imposed monetary penalties totalling Rs 88 lakh on the company and other individuals for various violations of securities market regulations
